translations.web: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
translations.bsb: He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.
translations.kjv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
